blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
It is the intent of the Legislature to enact legislation relating to civil procedure.
digest: Existing law establishes various requirements and limitations on civil actions, civil procedure, the courts, and related matters, as specified.
This bill would express the intent of the Legislature to enact legislation relating to civil procedure.
label: Introduced
subject: Civil procedure.
title: An act relating to civil procedure.
